seo.title: Unfair Dismissal After 6 Months: What Barbershops Must Know
seo.description: From 1 January 2027, employees can claim unfair dismissal after six months, not two years. What it means for barbershop hiring, probation and records.

media.anchor: Timing is set by the "effective date of termination"
media.alt: General two-year ordinary unfair dismissal qualifying period changing to six months from January 2027, depending on effective employment termination date
media.caption: The 2027 ordinary unfair-dismissal qualifying-period change. Some day-one legal protections remain; the effective termination date matters
